scope: New CPU-only HTTP benchmark on 14 Nov 2026; no new training or GPU. Original measurement receipt is retained unchanged.
dirty_state_explanation: Documentation and verification tools were being improved; each of the five runtime files listed in measurement.json exactly matches this base revision. No model or serving rule was edited.
versions_difference: macOS ARM64 CPU, Python 3.12; NumPy 2.3.5 replaces original Colab 2.1.3 because Ultralytics 8.4.182 excludes NumPy 2.1.x on Darwin. Other original direct pins retained. This is not the original T4 environment.
input_source: Oxford-IIIT Pet public archive via mirror; archive MD5 5c4f3ee8e5d25df40f4fd59a7f44e54c; each of 50 input image MD5 values matches frozen split-v1 metadata.
input_order: The first 50 frozen-v1 test IDs were selected before inference, then sorted by filename and cycled six times. Five warm-up requests precede 300 timed requests. No metric or threshold selection.
measurement_limits: One client/worker, loopback, batch 1; no concurrency/load test. RSS samples every 20 ms are process-only decimal MB, not total-system memory. OMP/MKL/OpenBLAS requested 2 threads; actual framework thread counts were not separately recorded. Performance is specific to this host/workload.
tool_format_note: Ruff formatting was applied after execution; the recorded pre-format tool hash is retained. The serving runtime was not changed.
